comments.text: I’m from Ecuador in 2019 I have been in Azerbaijan for two weeks and I been Traveling by all the country was amazing people, amazing food, rich in history and a lot of resources as gas and petrol. I loved that country 🙂🙂

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Two weeks travelling the whole country is a proper trip. The food and the hospitality come up again and again from viewers who have been — though the mountain villages in this film are the part most visitors never reach. Thank you for sharing it.
